entities.summary: Daniel Buda is a Romanian politician. He has been a member of the European Parliament since 2014. He is a member of the PDL, which was merged into the PNL in 2014. In the 2019 election, he ran as a member of the PNL, again becoming an MEP. He is affiliated with the EPP group.
